hints.title: Running Prefix Sum
hints.text: Compute the cumulative prefix sum at every step through the array.

hints.title: Find Minimum Valley
hints.text: Identify the lowest value reached by the cumulative sum at any point.

hints.title: Ensure Positive Balance
hints.text: If min_sum < 0, startValue must be 1 - min_sum. If min_sum >= 0, startValue 1 is sufficient.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing candidate start values incrementally from 1 upwards can be slow if numbers are large negatives.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass tracks the prefix minimum in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes the minimum cumulative prefix sum and returns max(1, 1 - min_prefix).
complexity.notes: Initial start value must be at least 1.
